text:
How platform components work together

Diagram
flowchart LR
    A[Requirements] --> B[Application designer]
    B --> C[User interface]
    B --> D[Data model]
    B --> E[Business logic]
    C --> E
    D --> E
    E --> F[APIs and integrations]
    G[Identity and security] --> C
    G --> D
    G --> E
    C --> H[Testing and preview]
    D --> H
    E --> H
    F --> H
    H -->|Approved| I[Build and deployment]
    H -->|Issues| B
    I --> J[Runtime and monitoring]
    J --> K[Usage and feedback]
    K --> B

The designer acts as the coordination layer: screens read and update the data model, business logic validates actions and runs workflows, integrations connect external services, and security controls access throughout. Testing checks the assembled application before deployment; runtime monitoring and user feedback then inform the next revision. Because the platform is unidentified, its exact component names and automation cannot be confirmed.
limitations: The platform was not identified, so this is a platform-neutral explanation.
